# Results to write

`{XTABLE}` - table of # of obs per taxa (EPT, IPP), per dataset (GBIF/iNat), per life stage (A/J) & combined

**raw inat data pull**

From the iNaturalist API, I pulled `{1XXX}` unique observations of Ephemeroptera, Plecoptera, and Trichoptera taken from Jan 2000 to Dec 2025, retaining only `{2XXX}` within the North America L1 ecoregion of the Eastern Temperate Forest. Because most of the covariate data is for the United States, I restricted the study extent to only the United States portion of the Eastern Temperate Forests in later filters. After adding quality control filters (e.g., positional accuracy, public licensing, temporal data) and during the image annotation process where I investigated further quality checks (e.g., duplicate images, observations unidentifiable to the order level), I retained a total of `{3XXX}` observations for all subsequent analyses (`{XTABLE}`). 

*use sankey diagram??*
1. pull taxon IDs from `raw_EPT`, get # of obs per taxa
2. pull taxon IDs from `raw_EUSA_EPT`, get # of obs per taxa
3. from `final_EUSA_EPT`, grab # of obs per taxa, per life stage

**clean inat data summary - order-level for SO1/2**

Of the iNaturalist observations included in the analyses, I found `{%%%%}` observations were not research grade, `{%%%}` had no annotations, and `{%%%}` only had one identification. There were `{XXX}` observers and `{XXX}` identifiers (supplementary methods acknowledging their contributions). The data in our EUSA study extent represents `{%%%}` of all global EPT observations. From my annotations, I found `{%%%}` immature and `{%%%}` adult observations

*from `final_EUSA_EPT`*

* add to sunburst chart? get # of obs w/& w/o annotations  (by taxa! make table combined)

**inat/gbif data summary - family-level for SO3**

*NEED TO DESCRIBE METHODS FOR THIS SELECTION - basically I grabbed the families & species with lowest amounts of data on iNat, then grabbed the corresponding families/spp data w/life stage metadata from the INHS dataset on GBIF, and selected the taxa with adequate data for modelling in both datasets (Isonychiidae, Ptero, Philo). iNat obs were considered "validated" at family level if they included at least 2 identifications* *i didnt filter dates for GBIF data...*

As part of SO3, I selected three aquatic insect families from each order (of EPT) with high data deficiency on both iNaturalist and GBIF. The three taxa were the families of Isonychiidae, Pteronarcyidae , Philopotamidae. These families do not necessarily represnt threatened taxa, but rather data deficient taxa - attributable to low sampling rather than taxa rarity. Isonychiidae has 17 spp in its family, Pteronarcyidae has 10 species, and  Philopotamidae has 42 species across North America (book). We did not validate our iNaturalist data to species-level, but when examining the GBIF data, we can see `X, Y, Z` species represented in the I, P, & P families, respectively.

To train models in SO3, I worked with the three family-level taxa selected above. `{XXX}` family had the most iNaturalist observations and GBIF records, whereas `{XXX}` had the lowest (FIG). Observations on iNaturalist were dominated by adult life stages `{%%% +- SD}`, while GBIF was/was not at `{%%% +- SD}`. The occurrences of each taxa were relatively well-distributed across the study extent for both species.

```{r}
  semi_join(raw_EUSA_EPT_df, by = "id") |> # Only keep EPT obs in the EUSA

# --- Cleaned observation data (script L202)

))

rm(raw_EUSA_EPT_sf, raw_EUSA_EPT_df)
```

## species totals

```{r}
#| label: get-num-spp-raw
MakePattern <- function(data) {
  string <- paste0("(^|,|/)", data, "(,|/|$)")
}

raw_EPT_totals <- raw_EPT |>
  # Dates 2000-2025
  filter(between(observed_on_details.year, 2000, 2025)) |>
  # Grab species label
  mutate(
    species = case_when(
      str_to_lower(taxon.name) == EPT[1] |
        str_detect(taxon.ancestry, MakePattern(EPT_id[1])) ~ EPT[1],
      str_to_lower(taxon.name) == EPT[2] |
        str_detect(taxon.ancestry, MakePattern(EPT_id[2])) ~ EPT[2],
      str_to_lower(taxon.name) == EPT[3] |
        str_detect(taxon.ancestry, MakePattern(EPT_id[3])) ~ EPT[3],
      .default = NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(species) |>
  # Summarize # obs, plec, tric
  summarize(num_obs_spp = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(total_obs = sum(num_obs_spp), dataset = "Raw Global EPT")
```


```{r}
#| label: get-num-spp-raw-eusa
raw_EUSA_EPT_totals <- raw_EUSA_EPT |>
  # Dates 2000-2025
  filter(between(observed_on_details.year, 2000, 2025)) |>
  # Grab species label
  mutate(
    species = case_when(
      str_to_lower(taxon.name) == EPT[1] |
        str_detect(taxon.ancestry, MakePattern(EPT_id[1])) ~ EPT[1],
      str_to_lower(taxon.name) == EPT[2] |
        str_detect(taxon.ancestry, MakePattern(EPT_id[2])) ~ EPT[2],
      str_to_lower(taxon.name) == EPT[3] |
        str_detect(taxon.ancestry, MakePattern(EPT_id[3])) ~ EPT[3],
      .default = NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(species) |>
  # Summarize # obs, plec, tric
  summarize(num_obs_spp = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(total_obs = sum(num_obs_spp), dataset = "Raw EUSA EPT")
```


```{r}
#| label: get-num-spp-final-eusa
final_EUSA_EPT_totals <- final_EUSA_EPT |>
  group_by(species, life_stage) |>
  # Summarize # obs, plec, tric
  summarize(num_obs_stage = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(total_obs = sum(num_obs_stage), dataset = "Final EUSA EPT") |>
  group_by(species) |>
  mutate(num_obs_spp = sum(num_obs_stage)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  relocate(num_obs_spp, .after = life_stage)
```


```{r}
#| label: create-spp-table
final_EUSA_EPT_totals_spp <- final_EUSA_EPT_totals |>
  select(-num_obs_stage, -life_stage) |>
  mutate(species = str_to_lower(species))

combined_spp_totals <- bind_rows(
  raw_EPT_totals,
  raw_EUSA_EPT_totals,
  final_EUSA_EPT_totals_spp
) |>
  distinct(dataset, species, total_obs, .keep_all = TRUE)

pivoted_spp_totals <- combined_spp_totals |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species,
    values_from = num_obs_spp
  ) |>
  relocate(total_obs, .after = last_col())


ft <- flextable(pivoted_spp_totals) |>
  set_header_labels(
    dataset = "Dataset",
    ephemeroptera = "Ephemeroptera\nObservations",
    plecoptera = "Plecoptera\nObservations",
    trichoptera = "Trichoptera\nObservations",
    total_obs = "Total EPT\nObservations"
  ) |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  autofit() |>
  align(j = c(2, 3), align = "center", part = "all")

doc <- read_docx() |>
  body_add_par("EPT Order-Level Summary", style = "heading 1") |>
  body_add_flextable(value = ft)

print(
  doc,
  target = here(L306_figs_dir, "306a_dataset_order_table.docx")
)

# Clean up
rm(
  raw_EPT_totals,
  raw_EUSA_EPT_totals,
  final_EUSA_EPT_totals_spp,
  combined_spp_totals,
  pivoted_spp_totals,
  ft,
  doc
)
```

```{r}
      "202a_images_clean_EUSA_EPT_obs.rds"

    join_by(observation_id == id)

  select(
    species,
    life_stage,
    observation_id,
    quality_grade,
```

```{r}
#| label: prep-research-grade
EUSA_EPT_obs_status <- final_EUSA_EPT_metadata |>
  filter_out(life_stage == "eggs") |>
  mutate(
    species = str_trim(species),
    life_stage = str_to_title(life_stage),
    species = factor(
      species,
      levels = c("Ephemeroptera", "Plecoptera", "Trichoptera")
    ),
    quality_grade = fct_recode(
      quality_grade,
      "Needs ID" = "needs_id",
      "RG" = "research"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(species, life_stage, quality_grade) |>
  summarize(num_obs_stage_grade = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(species, life_stage) |>
  mutate(num_obs_stage = sum(num_obs_stage_grade)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(species) |>
  mutate(num_obs_spp = sum(num_obs_stage_grade)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    prop = num_obs_stage_grade / sum(num_obs_stage_grade),

    ls_label = paste0(
      life_stage,
      "\n",
      str_trim(format(as.numeric(num_obs_stage), big.mark = ","))
    ),
    taxa_label = paste0(
      species,
      "\n",
      str_trim(format(as.numeric(num_obs_spp), big.mark = ","))
    ),
    grade_label = paste0(
      quality_grade,
      "\n",
      str_trim(format(as.numeric(num_obs_stage_grade), big.mark = ","))
    ),
    ls_fill_key = paste(species, life_stage, sep = " - "),
    grade_fill_key = paste(species, life_stage, quality_grade, sep = " - ")
  ) |>
  arrange(species, life_stage, quality_grade)
```

### create viz

```{r}
#| label: create-rg-sunburst
# Inner Ring Summary (Species)
species_summary <- EUSA_EPT_obs_status |>
  group_by(species, taxa_label) |>
  summarise(prop_species = sum(prop), .groups = "drop")

# Middle Ring Summary (Life Stage)
lifestage_summary <- EUSA_EPT_obs_status |>
  group_by(species, life_stage, ls_fill_key, ls_label) |>
  summarise(prop_ls = sum(prop), .groups = "drop")


# Create plot
grade_plot <- ggplot(EUSA_EPT_obs_status, aes(y = prop)) +
  # Ring 1: Species
  geom_bar(
    data = species_summary,
    aes(x = 0.8, y = prop_species, fill = species),
    stat = "identity",
    width = 1.6,
    position = "stack",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = species_summary,
    aes(x = 0.8, y = prop_species, label = taxa_label, group = species),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 4.2,
    color = "white",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  # Ring 2: life stage
  geom_bar(
    data = lifestage_summary,
    aes(x = 2, y = prop_ls, fill = ls_fill_key),
    stat = "identity",
    width = 0.8,
    position = "stack",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = lifestage_summary,
    aes(x = 2, y = prop_ls, label = ls_label, group = ls_fill_key),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Ring 3: grade status
  geom_bar(
    aes(x = 2.8, y = prop, fill = grade_fill_key),
    stat = "identity",
    width = 0.8,
    position = "stack",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 3.6, y = prop, label = grade_label, group = grade_fill_key),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3.2,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y", clip = "off") +
  xlim(-0.2, 4.2) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Quality-Grade Observation Data Across iNaturalist Data, Taxa, and Life Stage"
  )


ggsave(
  filename = here(
    L306_figs_dir,
    "306_inat_obs_taxa_stage_grade.png"
  ),
  plot = grade_plot,
  width = 16,
  height = 10,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```


```{r}
#| label: create-rg-table
summary_table_data <- EUSA_EPT_obs_status |>
  mutate(
    # Percent of total dataset
    pct_total = percent(
      num_obs_stage_grade / sum(num_obs_stage_grade),
      accuracy = 0.1
    ),
    # Percent within each species
    pct_within_spp = percent(num_obs_stage_grade / num_obs_spp, accuracy = 0.1),
    # Format counts with commas
    count_formatted = format(num_obs_stage_grade, big.mark = ",")
  ) |>
  select(
    `Order` = species,
    `Life Stage` = life_stage,
    `Quality Grade` = quality_grade,
    `Observations (N)` = count_formatted,
    `% of Total` = pct_total,
    `% within Order` = pct_within_spp
  )

ft <- flextable(summary_table_data) |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  bold(part = "header") |>
  align(j = 1:3, align = "left", part = "all") |>
  align(j = 4:6, align = "right", part = "all") |>
  autofit() |>
  padding(padding = 6, part = "all")

doc <- read_docx() |>
  body_add_par("EPT Observation Summary Table", style = "heading 1") |>
  body_add_par(
    "Breakdown of observation counts and percentages by order, life stage, and quality grade.",
    style = "Normal"
  ) |>
  body_add_flextable(ft)

# Save Word doc
print(doc, target = here(L306_figs_dir, "306_inat_obs_table.docx"))
```

```{r}
#| label: create-num-id-ann-bar
# [X] annoted/not (bar)
# [X] # IDs (bar)

combined_ids_ann <- EUSA_EPT_ids_count |>
  left_join(EUSA_EPT_ann_count, join_by(species, life_stage, observation_id)) |>
  mutate(total_ann_count = replace_na(total_ann_count, 0)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(total_IDs_count, total_ann_count),
    names_to = "activity_type",
    values_to = "n_actions"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    activity_type = replace_values(
      activity_type,
      "total_IDs_count" ~ "Identifications",
      "total_ann_count" ~ "Annotations"
    ),
    activity_type = factor(
      activity_type,
      levels = c("Identifications", "Annotations")
    ),
    # Cap values at 5
    action_bin = if_else(n_actions >= 5, "5+", as.character(n_actions)),
    action_bin = factor(action_bin, levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5+"))
  ) |>
  group_by(activity_type, species, action_bin) |>
  summarise(num_observations = n(), .groups = "drop")

ids_anns_plot <- combined_ids_ann |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(action_bin), y = num_observations, fill = species)) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  # Count labels above each bar
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::comma(num_observations)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 2.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~activity_type, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::comma,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of Actions per Observation",
    y = "Number of Observations",
    fill = "Taxon",
    title = "Distribution of Identifications & Annotations per Observation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#F0F0F0", color = NA),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = here(L306_figs_dir, "306_inat_num_ids_ann.png"),
  plot = ids_anns_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: create-spp-table
# order of datasetes in table
dataset_order <- c("iNat Order", "iNat Family", "GBIF Family")

combined_spp_totals <- bind_rows(
  order_data_inat,
  family_data_inat,
  gbif_family_df_totals
) |>
  mutate(
    taxa = if_else(
      is.na(family) | family == "NA",
      order,
      paste0(family, " (", order, ")")
    ),
    life_stage = str_to_title(life_stage),
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = dataset_order)
  ) |>
  select(dataset, taxa, life_stage, num_obs = num_obs_stage)

# Subtotal rows
taxa_totals <- combined_spp_totals |>
  group_by(dataset, taxa) |>
  summarise(
    life_stage = "Taxa Total",
    num_obs = sum(num_obs),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

dataset_totals <- combined_spp_totals |>
  group_by(dataset) |>
  summarise(
    taxa = "Dataset Total",
    life_stage = "",
    num_obs = sum(num_obs),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Compile table rows
combined_all_totals <- bind_rows(
  combined_spp_totals |> mutate(sort_type = 1),
  taxa_totals |> mutate(sort_type = 2),
  dataset_totals |> mutate(sort_type = 3)
) |>
  mutate(
    taxa_sort = if_else(taxa == "Dataset Total", "ZZZ_Dataset_Total", taxa),

  ) |>

  select(dataset = dataset_char, taxa, life_stage, num_obs)

# Setup flextable
ft <- flextable(combined_all_totals) |>
  set_header_labels(

  ) |>
  theme_booktabs() |>
  autofit() |>
  merge_v(j = "dataset") |>
  valign(valign = "center", part = "body") |>
  align(j = 4, align = "right", part = "all")

dataset_summary_rows <- which(combined_all_totals$taxa == "Dataset Total")
inat_order_rows <- which(combined_all_totals$dataset == "iNat Order")

)
inat_fam_rows <- which(combined_all_totals$dataset == "iNat Family")
gbif_rows <- which(combined_all_totals$dataset == "GBIF Family")

ft <- ft |>

  bg(i = inat_fam_rows, j = "dataset", bg = "#DCDCDC", part = "body") |>
```

```{r}
#| label: create-spp-fig
dataset_order <- c(
  "iNaturalist Order-Level Dataset",
  "iNaturalist Family-Level Dataset",
  "GBIF Family-Level Dataset"
)

combined_spp_totals <- bind_rows(
  order_data_inat |> mutate(dataset = "iNaturalist Order-Level Dataset"),
  family_data_inat |> mutate(dataset = "iNaturalist Family-Level Dataset"),
  gbif_family_df_totals |> mutate(dataset = "GBIF Family-Level Dataset")
) |>
  filter_out(
    dataset == "iNaturalist Order-Level Dataset" & life_stage == "eggs"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    taxa = if_else(
      is.na(family) | family == "NA",
      order,
      family
    ),
    life_stage = str_to_title(life_stage),
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = dataset_order),
    fill_key = factor(
      paste(order, life_stage, sep = " - "),
      levels = c(
        "Ephemeroptera - Adult",
        "Ephemeroptera - Immature",
        "Ephemeroptera - Eggs",
        "Plecoptera - Adult",
        "Plecoptera - Immature",
        "Plecoptera - Eggs",
        "Trichoptera - Adult",
        "Trichoptera - Immature"
      )
    ),
    order = factor(
      order,
      levels = c("Ephemeroptera", "Plecoptera", "Trichoptera")
    ),
    ls_label = paste0(
      life_stage,
      "\n",
      str_trim(format(as.numeric(num_obs_stage), big.mark = ","))
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    dataset,
    order,
    taxa,
    life_stage,
    ls_label,
    fill_key,
    num_obs = num_obs_stage
  ) |>
  arrange(dataset, order, taxa, life_stage) |>
  group_by(dataset) |>
  mutate(prop = num_obs / sum(num_obs)) |>
  ungroup()


taxa_summary <- combined_spp_totals |>
  group_by(dataset, order, taxa) |>
  summarise(
    num_obs_taxa = sum(num_obs),
    prop_taxa = sum(prop),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    taxa_label = paste0(
      taxa,
      "\n",
      str_trim(format(as.numeric(num_obs_taxa), big.mark = ","))
    )
  )


# Create plot
totals_plot <- ggplot(combined_spp_totals, aes(y = prop)) +
  facet_wrap(~dataset, ncol = 3) +
  # Inner Ring (x = 1): Taxa
  geom_bar(
    data = taxa_summary,
    aes(x = 1, y = prop_taxa, fill = order),
    stat = "identity",
    width = 2.0,
    position = "stack",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  # Inner Ring Labels
  geom_text(
    data = taxa_summary,
    aes(x = 0.75, y = prop_taxa, label = taxa_label, group = order),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 5.2,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "white",
    lineheight = 0.85
  ) +

  # Outer Ring (x = 2): Life Stage (inherits order's color shade)
  geom_bar(
    data = combined_spp_totals,
    aes(x = 2, y = prop, fill = fill_key),
    stat = "identity",
    width = 0.8,
    position = "stack",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  # Outer Ring Labels
  geom_text(
    data = combined_spp_totals,
    aes(x = 2, y = prop, label = ls_label, group = fill_key),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 4.5,
    color = "black",
    lineheight = 0.85
  ) +

  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(-0.2, 2.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  theme_void(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.2, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = -20, l = 5)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Observation Data Across iNaturalist and GBIF Datasets, Taxa, and Life Stage"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = here(
    L306_figs_dir,
    "306_obs_data_taxa_stage.png"
  ),
  plot = totals_plot,
  width = 21,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r}
# Helper function to process dataframes for aesthetic mapping
prep_taxa_data <- function(df_sf) {
  df_sf |>
    mutate(
      life_stage = str_to_title(trimws(life_stage)),
      family_lifestage = factor(
        paste(family, "-", life_stage),
        levels = names(shape_values)
      )
    )
}

gbif_sf <- prep_taxa_data(gbif_sf)
```

```{r}
#| label: FX-create-map
create_taxa_map <- function(data_sf, title_text, show_legend = FALSE) {
  # Get spatial extent limits from the study area polygon
  bbox <- st_bbox(study_area_sf)

  # Add buffer padding to prevent clipping
  x_range <- bbox["xmax"] - bbox["xmin"]
  y_range <- bbox["ymax"] - bbox["ymin"]

  xlim_padded <- c(
    bbox["xmin"] - (x_range * 0.03),
    bbox["xmax"] + (x_range * 0.03)
  )
  ylim_padded <- c(
    bbox["ymin"] - (y_range * 0.03),
    bbox["ymax"] + (y_range * 0.03)
  )

  p <- ggplot() +
    # Base map North America
    geom_sf(data = basemap_land, fill = "#EBEBEB", color = NA) +

    # Base map USA states
    geom_sf(data = basemap_states, fill = NA, color = "#CCCCCC", size = 0.3) +

    # Study area polygon
    geom_sf(
      data = study_area_sf,
      fill = "#D9E8F5",
      color = "#2B5C8F",
      size = 0.7,
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +

    # Occurrence data
    geom_sf(
      data = data_sf,
      aes(
        shape = family_lifestage,
        color = family_lifestage,
        fill = family_lifestage
      ),
      stroke = 0.8,
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +

    # Padded Viewport limits
    coord_sf(
      xlim = xlim_padded,
      ylim = ylim_padded,
      expand = FALSE
    ) +

    scale_shape_manual(values = shape_values, name = "Taxa & Life Stage") +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_values, name = "Taxa & Life Stage") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_values, name = "Taxa & Life Stage") +

    labs(title = title_text, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(
        color = "#D0D0D0",
        linetype = "dashed",
        size = 0.2
      ),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#C6E2FF", color = NA),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "#333333", fill = NA, size = 0.8),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
    )

  if (!show_legend) {
    p <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  } else {
    p <- p +
      theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "#C0C0C0")
      )
  }

  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: create-fam-maps
pacman::p_load(pak, rnaturalearth, rnaturalearthdata, patchwork)

# Grab basemaps
basemap_land <- ne_countries(
  scale = "medium",
  continent = "North America",
  returnclass = "sf"
)
basemap_states <- ne_states(
  country = "United States of America",
  iso_a2 = c("US", "CA"),
  returnclass = "sf"
)

# Create my maps
map_gbif <- create_taxa_map(gbif_sf, "GBIF Occurrences", show_legend = TRUE)
map_inat <- create_taxa_map(
  inat_sf,
  "iNaturalist Observations",
  show_legend = FALSE
)

# Combine using patchwork
fam_map_combined <- map_inat +
  map_gbif +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Family-Level Occurrence Distributions across Eastern USA",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 15)
    )
  )

# Display final figure
fam_map_combined
```

## Number of species in GBIF families


```{r}
#| label: num-spp-gbif-fam
family_spp_stats <- readRDS(here(
  L2_data_dir,
  "208c_low_obs_taxa_clean_EUSA_gbif.rds"
)) |>
  filter(family %in% family_gbif_list) |>
  # Get total occurrence count per distinct species
  group_by(order, family, species) |>
  summarize(
    n_sp_occurrences = n_distinct(occurrenceID),
    .groups = "drop_last"
  ) |>
  # Calculate Mean, SD, and spp count per fam
  summarize(
    num_species = n_distinct(species),
    mean_records = mean(n_sp_occurrences, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_records = sd(n_sp_occurrences, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Display the summary table
family_spp_stats

#   order         family         num_species mean_records sd_records
#   <chr>         <chr>                <int>        <dbl>      <dbl>
# 1 Ephemeroptera Isonychiidae            10         26.3       42.5
# 2 Plecoptera    Pteronarcyidae           6         27         26.1
# 3 Trichoptera   Philopotamidae          15         43.6       54.2
```

# inat order map

```{r}
#| label: prep-data
ept_sf <- final_EUSA_EPT |>
  filter(!is.na(long) & !is.na(lat)) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326)

ept_sf <- ept_sf |>
  mutate(
    clean_stage = case_when(
      grepl("adult", life_stage, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Adult",
      grepl(
        "immature|nymph|larva",
        life_stage,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      ) ~ "Immature",
      TRUE ~ tolower(trimws(as.character(life_stage)))
    ),
    order_name = trimws(species), # Order column
    map_lifestage = factor(
      paste(order_name, "-", clean_stage),
      levels = names(shape_values_order)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    plot_order = case_when(
      order_name == "Trichoptera" ~ 1,
      order_name == "Ephemeroptera" ~ 2,
      order_name == "Plecoptera" ~ 3
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(plot_order)
```


```{r}
#| label: set-colors
# Shapes by Order (21 = Circle, 22 = Square, 24 = Triangle)
shape_values_order <- c(
  "Ephemeroptera - Adult" = 21,
  "Ephemeroptera - Immature" = 21,
  "Plecoptera - Adult" = 22,
  "Plecoptera - Immature" = 22,
  "Trichoptera - Adult" = 24,
  "Trichoptera - Immature" = 24
)

# Border/Outline colors matching Order colors
color_values_order <- c(
  "Ephemeroptera - Adult" = "#1F77B4", # Deep Blue
  "Ephemeroptera - Immature" = "#1F77B4",
  "Plecoptera - Adult" = "#2CA02C", # Deep Green
  "Plecoptera - Immature" = "#2CA02C",
  "Trichoptera - Adult" = "#FF7F0E", # Deep Orange
  "Trichoptera - Immature" = "#FF7F0E"
)

# Interior fill colors: Order color for adults, transparent ("NA") for immatures
fill_values_order <- c(
  "Ephemeroptera - Adult" = "#1F77B4",
  "Ephemeroptera - Immature" = "NA",
  "Plecoptera - Adult" = "#2CA02C",
  "Plecoptera - Immature" = "NA",
  "Trichoptera - Adult" = "#FF7F0E",
  "Trichoptera - Immature" = "NA"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: make-order-map
# Calculate padded limits to prevent edge clipping
bbox <- st_bbox(study_area_sf)
x_range <- bbox["xmax"] - bbox["xmin"]
y_range <- bbox["ymax"] - bbox["ymin"]

xlim_padded <- c(
  bbox["xmin"] - (x_range * 0.03),
  bbox["xmax"] + (x_range * 0.03)
)
ylim_padded <- c(
  bbox["ymin"] - (y_range * 0.03),
  bbox["ymax"] + (y_range * 0.03)
)

order_map <- ggplot() +
  # 1. BASEMAP: North America Landmass
  geom_sf(data = basemap_land, fill = "#EBEBEB", color = NA) +

  # 2. BASEMAP: State Boundaries
  geom_sf(data = basemap_states, fill = NA, color = "#CCCCCC", size = 0.3) +

  # 3. STUDY AREA FOOTPRINT
  geom_sf(
    data = study_area_sf,
    fill = "#D9E8F5",
    color = "#2B5C8F",
    size = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

  # 4. ORDER OCCURRENCE POINTS
  geom_sf(
    data = ept_sf |> filter(!is.na(map_lifestage)),
    aes(
      shape = map_lifestage,
      color = map_lifestage,
      fill = map_lifestage
    ),
    stroke = 0.4,
    size = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~order_name, ncol = 3) +

  # Padded Viewport limits
  coord_sf(
    xlim = xlim_padded,
    ylim = ylim_padded,
    expand = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_values_order, name = "Order & Life Stage") +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_values_order, name = "Order & Life Stage") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_values_order, name = "Order & Life Stage") +
  guides(
    shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, stroke = 1, alpha = 1)),
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, stroke = 1, alpha = 1)),
    fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, stroke = 1, alpha = 1))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "EPT Order-Level Occurrences Across Eastern USA",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      color = "#D0D0D0",
      linetype = "dashed",
      size = 0.2
    ),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#C6E2FF", color = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "#333333", fill = NA, size = 0.8),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "#C0C0C0")
  )

# Display Map
order_map
```
